unitNotes.V-40b: Engine.growthItems (1 h, tier 1, R-S-22, R-C-51; for today-track V-43): growthItems(view) -> [{date, id, grows}], oldest first, listing exactly the units growth(view) counts, so growthItems(view).length === growth(view) for every view. It never shrinks: later events never remove or reorder an earlier item. id is the objective that made that day count: the first objective done that day, ordered by id; grows is that objective's Content.objectives element (the object itself). Pure; sample rows skipped exactly as growth skips them; with no Content.objectives (or not an array) it returns []. Export it beside growth in the return block. [The rest of this note, with the tests to write: tracks/CORE/briefs/engine/V-40b.md and tracks/CORE/contracts/engine.md (V-40b): read both before you build. V-19 and V-30 are not in this run.]
